data.name: Seraphiana
data.long_meaning:
Seraphiana is a name derived from the combination of the Hebrew words ‘seraphim’ and ‘Anna’. Seraphim means ‘fiery ones’ or ‘burning ones’, referring to the celestial beings that surround the throne of God in the Bible.
Anna, which is also of Hebrew origin, means ‘grace’ or ‘favour’. Therefore, Seraphiana embodies the idea of a woman who is full of grace and favoured by God, a heavenly being in her own right.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine favour and grace.
data.numerology_meaning: Seraphiana is a name that embodies the energy of the number 9. It represents humanitarianism, altruism, and the ability to inspire and uplift others.
